2026-10-02 pointwise bridge implemented in worktree /private/tmp/scalafim-fslr-inverse-20261001 (uncommitted; built against reframe4s 5f7152aa via -Dscalafim.reframe4s.build). PointMapUse.Inverse(InversePolicy) is now backed by reframe4s PointwiseInversion: new Inverted / InverseUnsolved outcomes, typed InverseFailure, BridgeExactness.Approximate(NumericalBridgeMethod.PointwiseFixedPoint) and BridgePlacement.inverseSummary. The lattice path is deleted.
Frozen-budget results, all PASS:
- P1: 32492/32492 Converged per hemisphere, max residual 1.0e-8 mm, max iterations 30 / 20.
- P2: placement vs the all-vertex oracle, max 1.50e-8 / 1.53e-8 mm.
- P3: 0 voxel disagreements on res-01 and res-02.
- P4: 15 consumer maps x 2 hemispheres, 0 coverage / 0 value / 0 sign disagreements and 0 BridgeUnavailable, through the production route (evidence disagreement-pointwise-{beta,fir}.json).
- P5: medial wall vertex-exact (2796 / 2776), 0 BridgeUnavailable, inflated/veryinflated identity.
- P6-JVM: 8.7 s for admission, placement and GM mapping of both hemispheres (budget 30 s). The scope correction was recorded earlier; the first run measured 37.9 s including asset loading under load.
- P6-JS (real field, Node 26, fastopt): placement of both hemispheres 31.0 s (budget 120 s); load including SHA-256 and decode 12.5 s; placements match the oracle at the same 1.5e-8 mm as the JVM.
Observations: (a) the pre-existing TemplateSphereFilesSuite intermittently exceeds munit's 30 s timeout under heavy host load (load average 26-53). It passes at the c6030454 baseline and on the branch when the load drops; timings track load, not configuration. Not caused by this change. (b) Concurrent plain-sbt processes from other sessions sharing ~/.sbt staging caused NoClassDefFoundError in the build-definition loader. Runs now use the worktree's private sbt-warm base via -Dsbt.global.base.
